Vacancy

CRM Specialist (Salesforce & HubSpot)

Apply now

Position Title: CRM Specialist

Experience Required: 5-8 Years

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled CRM Specialist with mandatory hands-on experience in Salesforce and HubSpot. The ideal candidate must have end-to-end operational expertise in HubSpot and strong reporting capabilities in Salesforce. This role requires deep understanding of CRM automation, lead lifecycle management, and performance reporting.

Job Responsibilities:

HubSpot (End-to-End Management)

  • Complete ownership of HubSpot CRM operations
  • Lead scoring setup and optimization
  • Workflow automation setup and management
  • Landing page creation and optimization
  • Email campaign setup and automation
  • Pipeline management and lifecycle stage configuration
  • Integration with marketing and sales tools
  • Data hygiene, segmentation, and database management

Salesforce (Reporting & Analytics)

  • Creation and management of reports and dashboards
  • Sales performance tracking and analysis
  • Data validation and CRM hygiene
  • Custom report building for sales and leadership teams
  • Performance insights and forecasting support

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of CRM experience
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Salesforce (Reporting)
  • Mandatory end-to-end operational expertise in HubSpot
  • Strong knowledge of lead scoring models and automation workflows
  • Experience in landing page creation within HubSpot
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills
  • Understanding of sales funnel management
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations and APIs is a plus
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Key Competencies

  • Analytical mindset
  • Process-oriented approach
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration skills
